profile.headline: Software doesn’t fix a bad process
profile.summary:
I'm a developer that loves designing systems and using technology to solve problems.

Things I'm really good at: SharePoint, HTML, CSS, jQuery, C#, MSSQL, DNS, IIS, Kesterel, .NET Core, Entity Framework, Bootstrap, APIs, Identity Server

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · System Design · Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) · API Development · Postman · REST APIs · IBM Db2 · xUnit · Troubleshooting · SQL · C# · .NET

positions.title: Principal Applications Developer
positions.description: SharePoint/.NET developer working to build development practice in house.  Create online loan application products, support dealer extranet, and develop internal applications to support accounting and loan processing activities.  Establish standards for development team and create core frameworks for team to utilize in projects.  Plan and execute server and software upgrades for both custom and 3rd party applications.  Provide guidance to Director of IT for audits, upgrades, and project plans.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Develop applications on Web and Desktop to meet the needs of client that are in a variety of industries including healthcare, financial, and marketing.

positions.title: Web Technical Analyst
positions.description: I work in the Engineering and Collaboration Applications group as a web developer and SharePoint admin. I primarily develop custom and out of the box solutions on SharePoint (C#.NET), manage and maintain Donaldson's legacy public web and new SharePoint based sites, and have a few minor projects using other assorted platforms including Java/Oracle and PHP/MySQL.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Intern in the Engineering and Collaboration Applications group.
